title: Why Do Markets Exist?
hook: Markets exist because buyers and sellers need each other. That's it.
mission: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to explain why price can't move without participation — and use that to weigh how much a move actually means.

blocks.heading: Markets exist because people need to exchange something

beats.heading: In, out, protect, profit
beats.body: One side wants in. One side wants out. One side wants protection. One side wants profit. No exchange = no market, and no market = no movement.

beats.heading: A meeting place for decisions
beats.body: Buyers say "I'll pay this," sellers say "I want that," and price moves until both sides meet. That negotiation is what prints the chart.

blocks.heading: Follow the participation
sequence: Quiet overnight session, almost no orders
blocks.askAfter: Quiet overnight session, almost no orders
blocks.prompt: What happens to price with barely any participation?

options.label: It stays muted — fewer buyers and sellers means less to print onto the chart
options.feedback: Right — no exchange happening means no real negotiation to move price.

options.label: It moves just as much as any busy session
options.feedback: Participation and movement are linked — fewer participants means less real price discovery.

blocks.quote: A market is just a meeting place for decisions. Buyers say "I'll pay this," sellers say "I want that," and price moves until both sides meet — that negotiation is what prints the chart.

questions.question: Why can't price move at all if literally no one wants to buy or sell?
options: Someone has to want in and someone has to want out for a trade — and a new print — to happen
Price always moves regardless of participation
Price only moves when the exchange forces it to
questions.why: Zero participants means zero disagreement to resolve into price.

questions.question: A level gets tested once overnight on thin volume, then again at the New York open on heavy volume. Which test tells you more?
options: The New York open test — more participants means more real information
They're identical — a test is a test
The overnight test, because it happened first
questions.why: Not all tests of a level are equal — the one with more real participation carries more weight.

takeaways: No exchange happening means nothing is pushing price anywhere.
More real participation means a move reflects more genuine agreement or disagreement.
Thin, quiet sessions deserve less weight than heavy-volume ones.
remember: Price only moves because someone wants in and someone wants out.
